newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Station Casinos cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Station Casinos cut to hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc analyst Bruce Turner cut the firm's rating of Station Casinos Inc to buy from hold on Thursday after the company posted lower-than-expected quarterly profits.

-- Station reported break-even operationg results for the fiscal first quarter ended June 30, 1997 after adjusting for some extraordinary items, Turner said in research note. That was well below his forecast of $0.12 a share. Net revenues also missed Turner's mark.
-- Turner said it may take longer for company to recover, and sharply cut fiscal 1998 targets to $0.31 from $0.75 and 1999 to $0.60 from $0.90.
